sections_breakdown.name: Sticky Navbar
sections_breakdown.spec: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF7F2]/90 border-b border-[#E5DDD3]. Features Atyra brand logo with a floral yarn mark, navigation links (Creations, Categories, Story, Why Us, Custom Order, Gallery, Contact), desktop CTA button 'Custom Order' in primary terracotta tone, and mobile drawer menu.

sections_breakdown.name: Hero Section
sections_breakdown.spec: Generous warm background with floating pastel badge 'Crafted by Hand • Made with Heart'. Large elegant serif title 'Handmade. Customised. Made with Love.' Split screen with two CTA buttons ('Explore Creations' & 'Request Custom Order'), trust indicators ('100% Bespoke Crafting', 'Worldwide Shipping', '4.9★ Rating from 500+ Happy Hearts'), and hero product showcase frame.

sections_breakdown.name: Short Brand Philosophy Intro
sections_breakdown.spec: Centred high-impact statement on a soft sage/blush highlight box: 'At Atyra, every loop of yarn, every ribbon wrap, and every hand-poured detail is imbued with warmth and intention.'

sections_breakdown.name: Explore Our Creations
sections_breakdown.spec: 6 category cards grid with soft hover image zoom, soft pastel tags, title, description, and 'Browse Collection' link.

sections_breakdown.name: Featured Creations
sections_breakdown.spec: 8-product grid with price tags ('Custom Quote' / 'Price on Request'), interactive image quick view modal, filter buttons, and instant 'Enquire / Customise' trigger that auto-scrolls or pre-fills the Enquiry Form.

sections_breakdown.name: About Atyra Storytelling
sections_breakdown.spec: Long storytelling section detailing the artisan journey, artisan hands shaping gifts, commitment to slow crafts, ending with the signature quote: 'Made by hand. Created for you.'

sections_breakdown.name: Why Choose Atyra
sections_breakdown.spec: 6 feature cards with delicate line icons: 100% Handcrafted, Bespoke Customisation, Eco-conscious Packaging, Thoughtful Gifting, Artisanal Quality, Heartfelt Personalisation.

sections_breakdown.name: Custom Orders Enquiry Form
sections_breakdown.spec: Comprehensive interactive enquiry form with inputs: Name, Email, WhatsApp number, Occasion, Product Type, Colour/Theme preference, Budget Range, Quantity, Preferred Delivery Date, Special Details/Instructions, and an interactive Inspiration Image upload container with file preview simulation. On submit, shows a beautiful summary drawer/modal with instant WhatsApp pre-formatted message generation.

sections_breakdown.name: Occasions Ribbon
sections_breakdown.spec: 8 interactive occasion chips (Birthdays, Weddings, Anniversaries, Baby Showers, Corporate Milestones, Festivals, Graduation, Self-Care Treats) with clickable filter effect and CTA button 'Find Gifts for Your Occasion'.

sections_breakdown.name: Filterable Gallery Grid
sections_breakdown.spec: Masonry/grid layout with category tabs (All, Hampers, Crochet, Accessories, Bouquets, Custom Gifts) and image lightbox popover.

sections_breakdown.name: Instagram Live Showcase
sections_breakdown.spec: Header 'See What We're Creating' (@atyra.crafts) with 4-card grid showing behind-the-scenes craft reels/photos and hover stats.

sections_breakdown.name: Contact & WhatsApp Studio
sections_breakdown.spec: Warm aesthetic container 'Let's Create Something Beautiful' featuring studio address, response time guarantee, email, and a high-visibility green WhatsApp chat button linking directly to WhatsApp API.

sections_breakdown.name: Premium Boutique Footer
sections_breakdown.spec: Deep warm earthy footer with newsletter subscription ('Join the Atyra Love Letter'), quick navigation, craft care guide link, social icons, and copyright note.

testing_attributes.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, filters, modals) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the frontend using React in JavaScript (.js / .jsx files). Ensure code is clean, modular, and fully functional.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for navbar or popovers. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FAF7F2]/90 or bg-white.
Follow the exact colour palette: Soft cream/off-white background (#FAF7F2 / #FFFDF9), warm beige (#E8DFD8), blush pink (#F7E1D7), terracotta accents (#C87D67), sage (#D8E2DC), and lavender (#E5DBEC).
Use Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond for headings and Outfit or Manrope for body text via Google Fonts.
Ensure the Custom Order form has real state handling, form validation, image upload dropzone UI simulation, and triggers a modal summary + WhatsApp deep link option.
Add interactive toast feedback using Sonner when user submits custom order, copies contact info, or subscribes to newsletter.
Ensure responsive layout for all screen sizes from mobile (375px) to desktop (1440px).
